2 	# number of units
# room_a
{
	1 	# version
	room_a 	# foldername
	2 2 	# dX/dZ ; cell size
	0 	# room type
	0 0 	# room Flags
	1 	# num doors
	0 	# index
	0 0 1 	# dir/offs/wpindex
	1 	# door links
}
# room_b
{
	1 	# version
	room_b 	# foldername
	1 1 	# dX/dZ
	0 	# room type
	0 0 	# room Flags
	0 	# num doors
	1 	# index
	0 0 0 	# dir/offs/wpindex
	0 	# door links
}
